title: detect_onnx
description: Runs a YOLO-style ONNX detection model on decoded frames and publishes detection events, with optional ReID embeddings.

model_path.description: Path to the ONNX detection model.

input_size.description: Square network input size in pixels.

conf_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for a detection to be reported.

frame_width.description: Width of incoming RGB24 CPU frames; CPU frames are skipped while 0.

frame_height.description: Height of incoming RGB24 CPU frames; CPU frames are skipped while 0.

reid.description: Attach an appearance embedding to each detection.

reid_model_path.description: Optional ReID ONNX model; without it the embedding is an HSV colour histogram.

reid_input_w.description: ReID model input width in pixels.

reid_input_h.description: ReID model input height in pixels.

ep.description: ONNX Runtime execution provider; cuda needs a CUDA build and others fall back to CPU.

class_filter.description: Class ids to report; empty reports all classes.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to process; empty processes every stream.

class_names.description: Labels indexed by class id; empty uses the COCO-80 names.

roi_motion.description: CUDA path: infer only on regions that moved, with a periodic full-frame sweep.

motion_downscale.description: CUDA motion gate cell size in pixels.

motion_threshold.description: CUDA motion gate per-cell luma difference threshold.

motion_min_changed.description: Changed cells needed per region; 0 means max(8, cells/400).

max_regions.description: Maximum motion regions inferred per frame.

full_sweep_sec.description: Seconds between full-frame sweeps when roi_motion is on.

shared_engine.description: With ep cuda, use the process-wide batched inference engine; disables roi_motion.

shared_max_batch.description: Maximum requests batched into one shared-engine run.

shared_max_wait_us.description: Microseconds the shared engine waits for a batch to fill.
